algorithm: If n is 1, return 1 if k==0 else 1 (since 1^k=1 for any k)
Factorize n into its prime factors: n = \prod_{i=1}^\omega p_i^{m_i}
For each prime factor p_i with exponent m_i, compute the geometric series sum: S_i = 1 + p_i^k + p_i^{2k} + ... + p_i^{m_i k}
Multiply all S_i together to get \sigma_k(n)
Return the product as the result
constraints: n must be a positive integer <= 1000
k must be an integer between 0 and 4 inclusive
The result must be an exact Python integer
edge_cases: k=0: \sigma_0(n) = number of divisors of n
k= 4: \sigma_4(n) = sum of fourth powers of divisors
inputs: n: positive integer <= 1000, k: integer in 0..4
purpose: Calculate the divisor function \sigma_k(n) for positive integer n, which is the sum of k-th powers of all positive divisors of n.
